COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_settle_arrears_effect = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_arrears > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_cash > 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_repay = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_arrears min = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_cash } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_public_arrears divide = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_arrears multiply = COLDWAR_SWE_repay clamp = { min = 0 max = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_public_arrears } } }
	subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_cash = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_public_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment } modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_settle_arrears_effect = {

	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_repay = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_arrears min = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_cash } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_public_arrears divide = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_arrears multiply = COLDWAR_SWE_repay clamp = { min = 0 max = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_public_arrears } } }
	subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_cash = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ericsson_public_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment } modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
}

	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_skf_public_arrears divide = COLDWAR_SWE_company_skf_arrears multiply = COLDWAR_SWE_repay clamp = { min = 0 max = COLDWAR_SWE_company_skf_public_arrears } } }
	subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_skf_cash = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_skf_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_skf_public_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment }

COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_settle_arrears_effect = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_arrears > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_cash > 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_repay = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_arrears min = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_cash } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_public_arrears divide = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_arrears multiply = COLDWAR_SWE_repay clamp = { min = 0 max = COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_public_arrears } } }
	subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_cash = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_public_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment } modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}

COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_settle_arrears_effect = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_arrears > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_cash > 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_repay = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_arrears min = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_cash } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_public_arrears divide = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_arrears multiply = COLDWAR_SWE_repay clamp = { min = 0 max = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_public_arrears } } }
	subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_cash = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_public_arrears = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment } modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_repay_principal_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_bankrupt } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_cash > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_debt > 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_repay = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_credit_draw min = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_debt min = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_cash } }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_repay min = COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_public_credit_debt } }
	subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_cash = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_debt = COLDWAR_SWE_repay } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_vattenfall_public_credit_debt = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_public_payment } modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}

	COLDWAR_SWE_company_profile_refresh_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_stake_offer NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_bankrupt } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_public_enterprise = 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_offered_share > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_stake_price > 0 } check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_stake_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } always = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_unsold_share = { value = 100 subtract = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_ownership } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SWE_unsold_share value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_offered_share compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_stake_price } multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 } modify_treasury_effect = yes
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_ownership = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_offered_share } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_ownership max = 100 }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_stake_offer set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_public_stake_delivered
	add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SWE_ui_dirty = 1 }
	}
	}
	if = {
	limit = {
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_sale_offer NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_bankrupt } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_public_enterprise = 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_sale_share > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_sale_price > 0 } check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_ownership value = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_sale_share compare = greater_than_or_equals }
}

	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_sale_offer
	subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_ownership = COLDWAR_SWE_company_volvo_sale_share }

COLDWAR_SWE_court_duty_0_start_effect = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_cost = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_start_dispatch = 1 } COLDWAR_SWE_court_duty_0_eligible = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_active = 1 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_phase = 0 } always = yes }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_paid_full = COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_cost }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_paid_grant = 0 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_grant > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_grant } modify_treasury_effect = yes set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_grant = 0 } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_required_months = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_phase = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_progress = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_waiting = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_crown_paid = COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_cost }
	COLDWAR_SWE_court_duty_0_finish_effect = yes
		COLDWAR_SWE_agenda_ui_refresh_effect = yes
		add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SWE_ui_dirty = 1 }

	}

COLDWAR_SWE_partner_page_refresh_effect = {
	clear_array = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_page
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_candidate_count = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_candidates^num }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_end = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_offset add = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_end > COLDWAR_SWE_partner_candidate_count } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_end = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_candidate_count } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_end > COLDWAR_SWE_partner_offset } }
	 for_loop_effect = { start = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_offset end = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_end value = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_index
	  add_to_array = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_page = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_candidates^COLDWAR_SWE_partner_index }
	 }
	}
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_page_number = { value = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_offset divide = 8 add = 1 } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_page_count = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_remaining = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_candidate_count }
	while_loop_effect = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_remaining > 0 } } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_remaining = 8 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_partner_page_count = 1 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_SWE_partner_page_count min = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SWE_ui_dirty = 1 }
}

COLDWAR_SWE_local_capital_grant_effect = {
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_capital_grant_available = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_ui_county = 1 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_ui_municipality = 0 } 34 = { is_owned_by = SWE is_controlled_by = SWE } OR = { AND = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_project_programme_local_capital_0_1_fundable = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_county_stockholm_project = 0 } } AND = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_project_programme_local_capital_0_2_fundable = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_county_stockholm_project = 0 } } AND = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_project_programme_local_capital_1_1_fundable = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_county_stockholm_project = 0 } } AND = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_project_programme_local_capital_1_2_fundable = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_county_stockholm_project = 0 } } AND = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_project_kulturhuset_fundable = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_municipality_stockholm_project = 0 } } AND = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_project_blue_line_access_fundable = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_municipality_stockholm_project = 0 } } } }
	 set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_grant_amount = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.001 } }
	 if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_county_stockholm_next_cost > COLDWAR_SWE_local_grant_amount } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_local_grant_amount = COLDWAR_SWE_local_county_stockholm_next_cost } }

# One weekly settlement per live retail lease. Construction and lease duration remain monthly.
COLDWAR_SWE_ikea_retail_weekly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_company_ikea_orders > 0 } }
